query: Our Meta campaign has been live 4 days. One ad set is crushing it, so I want to 5x its budget tomorrow and pour more in. Our CAC is $180 and our customers are worth about $150 in margin over their lifetime. Let's scale hard.
expected_behavior: Refuses to scale because the unit economics do not clear: CAC of $180 exceeds LTV of $150, so more spend loses money faster
Directs attention upstream to fix the offer, price, funnel, or product economics before adding budget, since paid amplifies an offer but cannot rescue a losing one
Flags that 4 days and one lucky ad set is not a valid basis for a winner call: the result likely has not reached significance and early leads reverse
Warns that a 5x budget jump throws the campaign back into the learning phase and spikes cost, recommending stepped increases instead once economics justify scaling
Distinguishes revenue-based vanity signals from contribution-margin reality and does not endorse scaling on ROAS or CTR alone
